text:
maria: Starting regional rollout — plan is US -> EU -> APAC. Quick ops checklist: warm pool, staging drain, verify >=20% capacity cushion, set APAC fallback pin to v1.9. tagging @sam @liam for capacity readout.

deploy-bot: Canary started in us-east-1 · slice=slice-3 · instances=6 · target_traffic=2% · status=warming

sam: Warm pool progress: 6/8 gpus warmed (80%). Priming prefix/KV cache now with smoke prompts. ETA ~7m.

liam: Capacity snapshot: US fleet headroom = 28% sustained QPS; queue depth normal. Passing 20% cushion. Will keep polling.

maria: Good. Hold APAC pin until EU completes its canary window. If EU error_rate > 3% or p95 latency >2x, flip to pinned v1.9 and halt ramp.

ashley: Roger. Standby for manual pin if needed. Current fallback config: `region_fallback: true`, `fallback_model: redwood/llama-quant-v1.9`. Adding to release notes.

deploy-bot: Starting EU canary in eu-west-1 · instances=4 · target_traffic=1% · canary_window=10m

ravi: Ops note — APAC edge rack temps +3C above baseline but below alert threshold. I set thermal alert at +6C. No impact yet.

sam: Cache priming done for US canary. Sample latencies (US canary): p50=62ms, p95=120ms. Token error rate 0.1%.

liam: Observability: no error spikes in last 6m. EU canary within expected bounds so far. Holding until canary window ends before next ramp.

deploy-bot: EU canary window complete · metrics OK · proceeding to scheduled ramp: eu traffic -> 10% per plan

maria: Proceed to ramp US to 10% now, target 30% after 15m if metrics stable. Rollback triggers reminder: >3% error over 5m OR p95 >2x baseline OR thermal alert on region. If triggered, page oncall and pin fallback.

ashley: Updating changelog and release notes with fallback/pinning instructions and rollback thresholds. Will link doc in #release-notes.

maria: Thanks — next status check at 1765012400. If anything unusual, shout here or call. :thumbsup:

liam: ACK. Monitoring dashboards on watch. :eyes:

deploy-bot: US ramp to 10% complete · slice-3 traffic increased · monitoring hooks active
